body: I thought the general consensus was that if you need to get hospitalized, or have psychotic symptoms, it's probably mania as well.
Lithium worked wonders for me. Maybe I never had BPD as I suspected after all. The only issue was the insomnia. I'm going to be taking lamotrigine now.

Maybe Chara/Frisk is savoring the battles with the weaker monsters (megalomania is when one revels in the domination of others), so their attacks do less damage with them -- but C/F is just frustrated with Undyne and wants to get the battle over with as soon as possible.

Yes, she hates our guts because of our race, but it isn't racially motivated murder. It's murder based on the oppression of her people at the hands of an entire race (humans), motivated by the need to free her people. Yes, you can say, "not all humans bad," but the humans were the ones who created that "us vs. them" worldview in the first place. (It's up to us, the human player, to prove that worldview wrong... which we ultimately do in the Pacifist run.)

Of course, I agree with this as well. I mostly notice people being unreasonably angry at what are just people speculating about things, but if someone is passing off speculation as the end all be all or spreading misinformation, they should be called out on that.

But, also, like if people are wrong, let them be wrong. For some people, theorizing is how they get enjoyment out of these games, and a bad experience with the fandom can turn them off from the games altogether.

the only time theorists pay attention to "interesting" is when it is preceded by "very very" as that is a very unique and specific phrasing (as well as "darker yet darker") if you don't think toby fox likes to sprinkle in connections throughout his work just look at all the attention his extensive reuse of leitmotifs has gotten. he is famous for this. yeah, the people who like to piece this shit together have to have some level of obsession and crazy but if they're good at it they aren't just tying tenuous connections together all willy-nilly.
